description: List the holidays and half-day (early-close) sessions for a market over a date range (defaults to the next ~90 days, max 730). Use markets_hours for the normal weekly schedule and markets_status for the live open/closed state.

from.description: Inclusive lower bound, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today.

market.description: Market slug, e.g. nyse, us_equities, forex, crypto.

to.description: Inclusive upper bound, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: from + 90 days. Max range 730 days.

name: markets_calendar
title: Market calendar
